`class WebpResourceFormat`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [WebpResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/WebpResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format of WebP files, still or animated.

## Description

An animated WebP plays as an animated image; any other WebP is a still image.

## Method details

<a id="WebpResourceFormat-method-supports"></a>

### supports

`boolean supports(byte[] header)` 

If `true`, `header` is a RIFF file of type `WEBP`.

<a id="WebpResourceFormat-method-decoder"></a>

### decoder

`IResourceDecoder decoder(Asset asset, byte[] header)` 

Returns an [`AnimatedResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/animatedresourcedecoder/) for an animated WebP, otherwise a [`RasterResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/rasterresourcedecoder/) with the WebP reader.
